positions.name: MonthlyCadenceRatification
positions.frame: Is the monthly rehearsal cadence being enacted as a live directive in the moment, or fixed afterward as a structured, standing operational parameter?
positions.why: src-1 performs the cadence as a spoken command ('run monthly from now on'), while src-3 restates the same cadence as a labeled, documented spec ('Cadence: monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals'). Both directional reads (power: legitimate/pressure mandate; relational: authority-ranking) converge on the same underlying decision expressed twice — once as enactment, once as record — so the pair coheres under a single read of how the cadence gets settled and fixed in place, even though the register shifts from command to specification.
